importantNotes: Negative marking: 25% or 1/4th of the total marks given for a correct answer will be deducted for each incorrect answer.
If more than one answer is given or if the candidate does not darken the correct circle on the answer sheet, 25% or 1/4th marks of the total marks will be deducted as a penalty for a wrong answer.
If the sum of final marks after applying negative marking results in a fraction, the fraction remains as it is and further actions are taken based on that.
If a question is left unanswered, no negative marking will apply.
Final merit will be based on the combined marks of objective examination and interview.
